questions.question: Explain why it is necessary to rewrite the equation in standard form (ax² + bx + c = 0) before attempting to factorise it.
questions.expected_answer: Standard form ensures all terms are on one side and the equation equals zero, which is required to apply the Zero Product Property at the end. It also clearly identifies the a, b, and c coefficients needed for the AC method.

questions.question: Describe the two conditions that the numbers 'p' and 'q' must satisfy when using the AC method to split the middle term.
questions.expected_answer: The two numbers, p and q, must multiply together to give the product of a and c (p × q = ac), and they must add together to give the linear coefficient b (p + q = b).

questions.question: When factorising by grouping, how do you know if you have made an error before proceeding to the final step?
questions.expected_answer: After factoring out the highest common factor from each of the two pairs, the resulting binomial inside the brackets must be identical. If the brackets do not match exactly, an error was made in splitting the middle term or factoring the pairs.
